crossRefs.note: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there…
for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and…
that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world…
Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and…
So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong…
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

parallels.note: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

translations.web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
translations.bsb: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
translations.kjv: That ➔ there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have ➔ the same care one for another.
translations.asv: that there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
